positive.not_applicable_reason: Every context has a separate counts-only control batch through all six arms, with the first available pair sum planted by word arithmetic. Empty bases retain a negative-only control and are never resampled. These are per-context controls rather than a separate treatment arm.

negative.not_applicable_reason: The same per-context batch includes the first generator-walk point missing from the complete word-arithmetic pair sumset. Full-sumset contexts retain their positive-only control; do not invent an impossible negative or resample. Every ordinary negative answer also receives complete word replay.

factors.name: instrument
factors.value: Two release examples from the same source and lockfile; identical binary within each measurement mode; commits/OCI/binary identities pending
factors.how: ordinary timing binary for clocks; counts-only accounting binary for all counted/control children. Both SHA-256 identities are recorded; never mix instrumentation modes in a contrast.

factors.name: curve_threshold
factors.how: The fixed registered roster and complete grid; report each cell.

factors.name: bases_and_queries
factors.value: 8 seeds per cell, 256 uniform public subgroup query points
factors.how: Compact recipe plus hashes; identical across arms. Hash parameters are supplied component inputs; their sampling is not method cost.

factors.name: base_seed
factors.how: SHA256 domain-separated base/query laws; seeds fixed before data.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Native L2 adapter still pending; no timing comparison without it.

factors.name: memory_layout
factors.value: Fresh process per batch; allocator/ASLR/page state
factors.how: Counts-only System wrapper observes current-thread requests in the cold interval, ending before teardown. No allocator hook in the timing binary. Requested layout bytes are not live/usable bytes, allocator arenas or RSS; compiler may elide/combine requests.

factors.name: warmup_order
factors.how: Seeded Fisher-Yates context/arm order, paired full reversal.

factors.name: threads
factors.how: One solver thread inside the fixed 4-vCPU worker allocation.

factors.name: interruption
factors.value: Original absolute deadline, no retries or restores
factors.how: Every failure and in-flight start remains in the append-only ledger.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Masking/export integration and independent audit are pending; no promotion allowed.

factors.name: fresh_process_and_order
factors.value: Separate child per arm-batch; seeded reverse-paired order
factors.how: The baseline and A/A alias differ only in independent process/order nuisance draws, never in the algorithm or query inputs.

seed_derivation.note: native-point-hash-pilot/v1 SHA256 rejection law; order_seed=0x706f696e74686173. Context and arm blocks reverse on the second round of each pair.

instance_sampling.rule: Registered prime roster, full 2x2x8 context grid; SHA256-rejection uniform subgroup query points and separate base RNG. No scalar labels enter child input.

blinding.how: Prototype counts-only analysis is unmasked. Canonical masked export/analysis is an explicit unresolved admission dependency; no winner or statistical promotion.

power.note: Up to 8 contrasts x 4 cells x 5 prefixes x 21 diagnostic metrics = 3360 descriptive pointwise cells. Five current/candidate contrasts plus prepared/ordered, ordered/hashed and hashed/fingerprint. No error-controlled test or promotion. Eight independent base seeds per cell; queries/repeats are not independent units. Missing metrics/clusters stay unavailable and forbid a ratio; zero baseline totals forbid ratios while absolute totals remain. No qualified power.

stopping_rules.rule: Exactly 192 per-context planted/negative controls + 64 forced-hash-collision controls + 192 counted diagnostic batches + 384 warmup + 1536 measured = 2368 planned child attempts. Controls/counts precede timing.
Stop at the first child/replay/resource/timeout failure, preserving the durable start/finish ledger and all remaining unattempted rows. Never retry or extend the original absolute deadline.

User budget exception 2026-11-08 waives account/lane headroom gating for this pilot within a USD 10 total ceiling, including builds, whole-worker/idle/failure costs and storage/transfer. At most two builds and one original 1800-second measurement attempt; zero automatic retries/restores. Stop at the pilot ceiling; do not reset its ledger.

Before a paid build require exact publication and fresh exact-source S3 upload/readback. Before measurements also require the completed frozen protocol and authenticated exact native image/L2/host/resource qualifications.

invalidation_rules: Mismatched input/schedule/artifact identity; duplicate or out-of-order ledger events.
Incorrect witness/absence or a resource limit labelled absent.
Timing below required native L2, missing host/resource inventory or any resumed interval.
Any missing/failed row prevents a complete-case count contrast; retain full flow instead.

decision_rule.text: Report deterministic paired diagnostic ratios by size/threshold/prefix, with independent base-seed clusters and descriptive pointwise intervals. Do not declare a winner, infer equivalence, promote a runtime gain or claim fastest implementation. Timing comparisons are refused by the prototype analyzer.
decision_rule.statistic: Ratios of totals across one counted record per independent base-seed context for all 21 diagnostics: five Current/candidate contrasts plus Prepared/Ordered, Ordered/Hashed and Hashed/Fingerprint. Missing seed clusters forbid ratios; zero baseline totals forbid ratios while complete absolute totals remain.
decision_rule.interval: Existing ecbench.stats linearised_ratio, log-scale Student-t pointwise 95% interval over 8 independent base seeds; no query/timing-repeat pseudoreplication.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Unpriced diagnostic count ratios only; no error-controlled multiple-comparison decision.

outputs: native-point-hash.pilot-analysis/v2 with full flow, eight paired contrasts, absolute totals, unavailable cluster counts and candidate_over_baseline; no timing comparisons

graphs: Unpriced count totals/paired ratios by arm contrast, cell and prefix, including A/A and undefined/missing values

inadmissible: Changing grid, query law, seeds, accounting or stopping after seeing native study data.
Reading development F17 controls or unpriced count ratios as runtime gains.
Using pointwise pilot intervals as multiplicity-corrected evidence or proof of equivalence.
Substituting an unrelated ECBench fixture or local timings for an admitted native study.
Treating the budget exception or a producer boolean as authentication, source/image binding, protocol freeze, measurement validation or authority to change shared account settings.
Dropping failures, duplicate/in-flight attempts, empty bases or full-sumset control exceptions.

literature.claim: Callbacks must not unwind or allocate recursively; optimizer may elide/combine allocation requests. Separate nonallocating counts-only System wrapper and ordinary timing build.

Public HashMap API does not expose internal SwissTable probe groups; logical lookups, hash calls and full-key comparisons do not measure those groups.
